# Parse countries for CY 1995 from the table
# Exclude: territories, regional aggregates (Other X, Total X, etc.), and headers

countries_1995 = {
    # Europe
    'Austria': 1961,

    'Russia': 1069,
    'Spain': 3842,
    'Sweden': 9367,
    'Switzerland': 18568,
    'Turkey': 2834,
    'United Kingdom': 103375,
    'Yugoslavia': 150,
    # Canada
    'Canada': 35840,
    # Latin America and Caribbean (individual countries only)
    'Argentina': 6759,
    'Bahamas': 61477,  # territory - exclude
    'Bermuda': 6226,  # territory - exclude
    'Brazil': 14826,
    'British West Indies': 148626,  # regional aggregate - exclude
    'Chile': 5184,
    'Colombia': 4892,
    'Ecuador': 846,
    'Guatemala': 472,
    'Jamaica': 329,
    'Mexico': 21375,
    'Netherlands Antilles': 9850,  # territory - exclude
    'Panama': 3347,
    'Peru': 1880,
    'Trinidad and Tobago': 485,
    'Uruguay': 534,
    'Venezuela': 2536,
}

# Exclude territories and regional aggregates
excluded = ['Bahamas', 'Bermuda', 'British West Indies', 'Netherlands Antilles', 
            'Other Europe', 'Other Latin America and Caribbean', 'Total Europe',
            'Canada', 'Total']

# Filter to get valid individual countries only
valid_countries = {k: v for k, v in countries_1995.items() 
                 if k not in excluded and not k.endswith(':') and not k.startswith('Total')}

max_country = max(valid_countries, key=valid_countries.get)
max_value = valid_countries[max_country]

print('Valid individual countries and their 1995 claims:')
for country, value in sorted(valid_countries.items(), key=lambda x: -x[1]):
    print(f'{country}: {value}')
    
print(f'\n ---')
print(f'Highest (excluding territories/aggregates): {max_country} = {max_value} million')
"
